newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Eindhoven airport cargo traffic up 11 percent.
newsitem.headline: Eindhoven airport cargo traffic up 11 percent.

text.p: Eindhoven Airport has seen an 11 percent increase in cargo volumes in the first nine months of the year, an airport statement said.
For the first nine months 16,184 tons of airfreight were handled compared to 14,565 tons for the same period in 1995.

Most of the airfreight handled by Eindhoven Airport is actually trucked to other major European airports. Scheduled daily trucks depart for Cologne, Frankfurt, Paris Charles de Gaulle, Paris Orly, Luxemburg, London Gatwick and London Heathrow. In the third quarter, from July to September this year, the Dutch airport handled 35 tons of "real" (non-trucked) airfreight, the statement added.

Passenger traffic for the same period rose by 19 percent to 192,870, compared to 161,887 passengers in the first nine months of 1995. Scheduled traffic went up by 18 percent to 147,665 passengers and holiday charter traffic increased 75 percent to 27,608 passengers. -- Air Cargo Newsroon Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
